title: Secrets Manager Rotation Failure — Service Auth Token Expiry
symptom: Services returning 401 Unauthorized after scheduled secret rotation; logs show 'invalid token' or 'signature verification failed'; Vault/AWS Secrets Manager rotation job marked as FAILED.
recommended_action: kubectl rollout restart deployment/<service-name> && vault write -force auth/token/renew-self
remediation_steps: Identify failed rotation: vault list secret/data/ && aws secretsmanager list-secrets --filter Key=tag-key,Values=rotation-failed
Force re-rotation in Vault: vault write -force secret/data/<path>
Update Kubernetes secret from new value: kubectl create secret generic <name> --from-literal=token=<new-value> --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
Restart affected deployments to pick up new secret: kubectl rollout restart deployment/<service-name>
Verify: kubectl exec <pod> -- env | grep TOKEN
